findings.title: Evidence timestamps only
findings.detail: The only evidence change is swapping axe run timestamps (03:25→03:48). No axe report bodies, measurement outputs, or other evidence files appear in the diff. Adding data-measure hooks in UI cannot be verified as re-measured; the meta touch alone does not prove a real measurement pass against this commit.

findings.title: Measurement hooks unverified
findings.detail: Diff adds data-measure="header" (Page), data-measure="mark" (BrandLogo), and data-measure="hero" (SitterSearchList) with no harness/script/report changes. Cannot verify these selectors are consumed or that width/theme/layout measurements were re-run after the markup change.

findings.title: Testid rename not fully verified
findings.detail: data-testid renames sitter-list → search-results (and adds sitter-list-item, filter-search, live-search). Only acceptance.spec.ts is updated in the diff. Cannot verify other specs, feature-audit manifests, or smoke scripts that may still target sitter-list; incomplete migration is a fail-closed gap.

findings.title: Acceptance search locator weakened
findings.detail: Search narrowing test stopped using getByLabel(/search sitters/i) and the submit button, and now only fills getByTestId('filter-search'). Live-narrow via applyQuery is consistent with SitterSearchList onChange, but the test no longer guards the accessible name of the search control—only a test id.

findings.title: Live filter wiring consistent
findings.detail: applyQuery sets query and submitted(trim) on each keystroke; onChange calls it; acceptance expects count to drop without submit. That behavioral coupling is internally consistent in the diff. Not a defect—but it is not proof the full suite is green or that production filtering matches.
